acceptance.result: SQLite and LanceDB adapters implement the same id/filter/space/generation contract. SQLite stores one active generation per namespace; the Electron journey switches portable to ANN and restores the active backend after restart.

The LanceDB adapter is a library-only owner-side retrieval seam. It does not load memory-lancedb recall/capture/store hooks, and vector rows contain identity plus vectors rather than answer-ready source text.

Coverage includes conditional prefilter, unindexed appended rows, deletion, model-space replacement with 768-to-4096 vectors, background optimize, old-generation cleanup, interrupted switching, restart recovery, ACL revocation and workspace isolation. Prior authorization is not revived.

Portable 20k and ANN 100k measured Recall@20 1.0 with P95 25.37 ms and 409.47 ms, plus RSS/disk. Missing native capability is reported and falls back to portable while ordinary Chat remains available.

LanceDB and Arrow dependencies remain in the memory-wiki owner package. Core consumes the public retrieval SDK; the ANN store is the registered derived-index exception while SQLite owns active generation state.
Planned unit and Electron tests are implemented and listed in requiredTests. All 21 formal gates exit zero on the clean source candidate.
